allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A self-indulgent private investigator winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

facts.overview: A self-indulgent private investigator winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.
facts.title: City Hunter

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Trapped on the high seas with ruthless gunmen and no rations, can a frivolous private eye outwit danger before the voyage goes completely off course?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Wong Jing's 1993 Hong Kong action comedy, a self-indulgent private investigator winds up trapped aboard a luxury cruise liner alongside wealthy socialites, glamorous passengers, scarce food, and ruthless terrorists.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, comedic action with low emotional weight, perfectly built for a high-energy, easygoing group watch.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Wong Jing delivers a fast, breezy blend of martial-arts action and broad farce, turning a high-stakes cruise hostage crisis into an energetic, lighthearted thrill ride.
